answer_1.quote: Data-to-text is a field of natural language generation (NLG) that focuses on converting structured, non-linguistic data into coherent text ... We presented a new way of training NLG systems for data-to-text problems ... The rule-based approach was trained only on the training part of the WebNLG dataset.
answer_1.outputs: textualisation of RDF triples (generated natural language sentences)

answer_2.quote: We investigate the quality of generated output using several popular metrics: BLEU, METEOR and BLEURT. Implementations of these metrics from HuggingFace are used.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a small-scale in-house human evaluation. We selected 75 instances from the test set... evaluated the outputs of our approach and both baselines... The annotation was performed by asking binary questions related to the existence of minor hallucinations, major hallucinations, omissions, disfluencies, and repetitions. The annotation was performed by five NLP experts, each output was evaluated by a single annotator.
answer_4.guideline: Binary questions about minor hallucinations, major hallucinations, omissions, disfluencies, and repetitions.
